title: SIFMA-recommended US fixed-income early close, 2:00 p.m. ET — the day after Thanksgiving, the one 2026 session where an 8:30 a.m. macro print gets five and a half hours of bond tape and three and a half of equity tape
source: NEWS: sifma.org/resources/general/holiday-schedule (SIFMA's own US Holiday Recommendations panel), re-fetched direct 2026-09-09 (HTTP 200, 299,159 bytes) by this event's initial research and parsed card-by-card in DOM order rather than inherited from the proposal. The 2026 US panel is the page's DEFAULT tab and renders 13 cards; card 11 reads verbatim 'Thanksgiving Day' / 'Thursday, November 26, 2026' / 'Early Close (2:00 p.m. Eastern Time): Friday, November 27, 2026'. PANEL ATTRIBUTION VERIFIED FIRST-HAND: cards 1-13 are the US panel (New Year's through New Year's 2026/2027, Eastern Time throughout), cards 14-31 the UK panel and 32-66 the Japan panel — and the UK and Japan panels' OWN Thanksgiving cards (28 and 62, both 'Thursday, November 26, 2026') carry NO early-close note, which is the negative control. The full 2026 US early-close set is 04-03 (12:00 p.m. ET, Good Friday), 05-22, 07-02, 11-27, 12-24 and 12-31; MLK, Presidents Day, Juneteenth, Labor Day, Columbus Day and Veterans Day 2026 carry no note. Independently reproduced by statute and weekday arithmetic: 5 U.S.C. 6103 fixes Thanksgiving on the fourth Thursday in November, November 2026's Thursdays are the 5th, 12th, 19th and 26th, so the day after the fourth is Friday 2026-11-27. Filed estimate on the same three counts every sibling SIFMA entry documents: the confirmed-prefix taxonomy in market-events-data.ts has no slot for an industry trade association's recommended schedule, this lane may not self-confirm an event it discovered in-sweep, and SIFMA's closes are recommendations non-binding by their own terms rather than a market-wide halt. The DATE is not in doubt — the estimate label is about the taxonomy, not the evidence. Checked 2026-09-09
notes: CANONICAL FILE WRITTEN BY THIS EVENT'S OWN never-assessed INITIAL RESEARCH (2026-09-09), shadowing the single proposal proposals/sifma-bond-early-close-2026-11-27.from-thanksgiving-market-closure-2026-11-26.json, which was read in full first and whose every schedule claim was re-fetched rather than copied. WHY IT IS NOT A DUPLICATE OF thanksgiving-half-day-2026-11-27, canonical on the same date: the two markets keep different hours on this session and in the unusual direction. NYSE footnote *** (nyse.com/markets/hours-calendars, re-fetched 2026-09-09, HTTP 200, 109,180 bytes) names 2026-11-27 by date and puts equities out at 1:00 p.m. ET and eligible options at 1:15; SIFMA recommends fixed income out at 2:00 p.m. ET. WHAT IS NEW FOR THE 2026 INSTANCE, against the 2027 sibling sifma-bond-early-close-2027-11-26: (a) every operative listing venue documents it — TLT, IEF, SHY and BND list on NasdaqGM (Yahoo chart metadata, read 2026-09-09), and nasdaqtrader.com/trader.aspx?id=Calendar (HTTP 200, 54,661 bytes) DOES publish 'November 27, 2026 | Early Close* - U.S. | 1:00 p.m.', closing the 2027 sibling's open note that Nasdaq had published no 2027 rows; (b) a scheduled macro release lands INSIDE the truncated session — census.gov/economic-indicators/calendar-listview.html (HTTP 200, 91,396 bytes) carries 'Advance Economic Indicators Report (International Trade, Retail, & Wholesale) | November 27, 2026 | 8:30 AM | October 2026', where 2027-11-26 had none; (c) the corridor is dense, not empty — 30 other tracked events sit within +/-5 days against the 2027 instance's 5, including the whole monthly coupon slate at D-4 to D-2 and PCE plus the second GDP estimate on 2026-11-25. NARROWING CARRIED FORWARD, so this row does not re-import a claim already corrected: it is NOT true that from 13:00 to 14:00 ET the Treasury tape is the only US price discovery running — the same NYSE footnote continues 'NYSE American Equities, NYSE Arca Equities, NYSE National, and NYSE Texas late trading sessions will close at 5:00 p.m.' What ends at 13:00 is the CORE session and the closing auction, so the accurate fact is that every listed bond proxy prints its official close an hour before the cash tape it tracks stops trading. THE ISSUER'S OWN TREATMENT, from a primary depending on neither holiday calendar and re-run this session: api.fiscaldata.treasury.gov auctions_query returns ZERO auctions on all 27 day-after-Thanksgiving dates 2000-2026 and 98 settlements across the same dates, and the 4-week/8-week bill slate displaces to the Wednesday before in 7 of 7 years 2019-2025. The November 2026 slate itself is NOT yet corroborable there — the dataset's most recent auction_date is 2026-09-10 and it carries results, not the forward calendar, which is why the tracked treasury-2y-note-2026-11-23, treasury-5y-note-2026-11-24, treasury-2y-frn-2026-11-24 and treasury-7y-note-2026-11-25 entries all remain estimate. Kind 'rates', impact low, symbols [] and status estimate copy sifma-bond-early-close-2027-11-26 exactly and invent no new kind; EventKind in src/domain/market-events-types.ts still has no market-structure member, which is the honest reason 'rates' is the closest fit. NOT PROPOSED, and named here so the next sweep does not re-derive them: the 2026-12-24 US bond early close (2:00 p.m. ET on the same panel, with christmas-eve-half-day-2026-12-24 already canonical on the equity side) is recorded and not proposed, following the precedent sifma-bond-early-close-2027-03-25, -2027-05-28 and -2027-11-26 all state — a structurally identical object with zero measured impact, where a proposal spends a session re-deriving the same nulls; and the Wednesday 2026-11-25 bill-auction displacement is left unfiled because this calendar tracks coupon auctions and carries no bill-auction entry of any kind, so filing one is a schema decision this lane declines to take in passing.
